dril bu lus dkyil sgom pa'i thog mar/ shrī ni gnyis med ye shes te// zhes sogs/ ngag tu bton nas dga' ba gsum nyams su myong ba'i ye shes kyi ngo bo de nyid/ lhag pa'i lhar bzhengs pa'i lus la/ dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par gsal 'debs pa yin gyi/ ma rig pa lhan skyes kyis btags pa'i gang zag dang chos thams cad dga' ba gsum po nyams su myong ba nyid kyis dmigs med du byas zin pa'i phyir dang*/ de las gzhan du na/ lam zab rgyun gyi rnal 'byor dang*/ rnal 'byor pa la dus tha ma'i cho ga byas pa'i tshe/ rtsa ltung brgyad pa nges par nyams su len dgos pa nyid du thal bar 'gyur ro// gnyis pa la dngos dang shes byed dgod pa'o// dang po ni/ spyir mi'i lus grub tsam nas/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor rang bcas su grub pa yin pas/ ma dag pa'i lus nyid/ lhar sgom par ma zad/ lha nyid yin no// zhes 'chad pa de dag ni/ lus la tha mal du zhen pa spong ba sogs/ phan yon du ma yod pa'i cha nas/ sgrub pa po dad pa'i rjes 'brang tsam du 'gyur mod/ chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba ni ma song ste/ lus dkyil la nyams len byed pa'i sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi rjes su yid la byed tshul rnams tshad ldan gyi sgrub dkyil nas bshad pa la/ brda don ma 'phrod par snang ba'i phyir/ ji ltar zhe na/ dang por/ rnal 'byor pa rang nyid ye shes lnga'i ngo bor gyur pa'i hūm̐ las/ lhag pa'i lha zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis par grub pa'i sku la/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par gsal 'debs pa de/ ngag tu 'don bzhin du yang go yul du mi 'jog par/ sgrub pa po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i tha mal gyi lus la/ lus dkyil rdzogs par grub zin pa de nyid sgom pa'i grub mtha' 'jog pa ni/ sngon 'gro dga' ba gsum ngos ma zin pas len pa dang*/ lus dkyil gyi rten brten pa kun/ ye shes su khas mi len par/

tha mal gyi phung khams skye mched du khas len pa ni/ bla mas lus dkyil du dbang bskur dus dang*/ phyis rang nyid der bdag 'jug len dus su/ swa bhā wa'i sngags kyis/ ma dag pa'i phung po lnga so so nas mi dmigs par byas/ stong pa de nyid kyi ngang las rgyal ba rigs lnga so sor yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bsgrubs nas/ nyams su len dgos pa de ma go bas nongs pa dang*/ gzhung las/ ji skad du/ 'di dag gnas su mkha' 'gro ma// rtsa gzugs mdzes pa yang dag 'dzin// dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni// lus kyi khams su rnam par brtag /ces gsungs pa des/ tha mal gyi rtsa khams nyid/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dngos su bstan no// zhes zer ba des ni/ lus dkyil gyi brten pa lha ngos 'dzin pa na/ chos rnams rang bzhin rnyog bral dag /sangs rgyas ye shes blta bar byos// zhes dang*/ pho brang lnga'i lha ngos 'dzin pa na/ phung po lnga dang nyon mongs pa lnga so so nas rnam par dag pa nyid/ rgyal ba rigs lnga 'khor bcas su ngos bzung ba de ma go bas nongs pa dang*/ lus kyi rtsa khams lha yin pa dang*/ lha rtsa khams kyi rnam par bstan pa'i rnam dbye ma phyed pas nongs pa dang*/ rten gyi gzhal yas khang byang phyogs so bdun gyi ngo bo nyid du gnas pa'i bshad pa byed bzhin du/ de 'dra de lus kyi gzhal yas khang la sbyor mi shes pas nongs pa'i phyir na/ sgrub pa po chos kyi rjes 'brang du ma song ngo*// 'dir cung zad spros na/ lus dkyil gyi rten brten pa'i rnam gzhag ni/ gdod ma nas byang phyogs so bdun gyi ngo bo nyid du grub pa yin gyi/ las dang nyon mongs pa'i rnam smin dang bdag po'i 'bras bu ni ma yin no// byang phyogs la yang*/ gnyis te/ rang bzhin rnam dag gi dang glo bur rnam dag gi'o// dang po ni/ gdod ma nyid nas bcos min gyi rten brten pa so so ba nyid ma yin pa'i dkyil 'khor du grub pa yin gyi/

mi'i lus gsar du grub pa la ltos dgos pa ma yin te/ ltos na gsar du bcos mar thal ba'i phyir ro// de lta mod kyi rnal 'byor pas lam du byed pa la ni/ mi'i lus su grub pa la ltos dgos pa yin te/ lus de'i gnas de dang der/ rten dang brten pa so so tha dad pa'i tshul gyis gsal 'debs dgos pa'i phyir/ dper na/ gnas tshul gyi rgyal ba rigs lnga chos kyi dbyings su ro gcig par bzhugs kyang*/ nyams len gyi tshe so sor brda 'phrod pa thig tshon dang*/ ri mor bris pa sogs dang*/ rnam shes kyi yul du so sor 'char ba la rag las pa bzhin no// de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa sna bdun ni/ ye shes su ro gcig kyang so sor ngo 'phrod pa mchod gshoms la rag las pa bzhin no// 'o na bcos ma bcos kyi dbye ba med par 'gyur ro// zhe na/ dbye ba de ni/ sgrub thabs dang sgrub pa po'i khyad par las te/ phyi dbyibs kyi dkyil 'khor gsar du 'chos dgos mi dgos kyi khyad par las so// rten brten pa thams cad rang bzhin rnam dag gi ye shes la 'jog na/ phyi nang gi dbye ba gang gis 'byed/ ce na/ sgrub pa po'i blo kun rdzob pa'i dbye ba las te/ don dam par ni/ ras bris dang rdul tshon yang*/ mi dmigs par byas zin pa'i 'og tu ye shes 'ba' zhig las grub dgos pa'i phyir ro// de ltar sgrub pa bcos ma gnyis la yin gyi/ lus dkyil la med do snyam na/ brtag par bya ste/ lus dkyil du dbang ma bskur bar ni/ de'i nyams len la 'jug tu mi rung la/ de'i dbang bskur ba'i tshe ni/ dpon slob gnyis kas slob ma'i phung po lnga dmigs med du gtong thengs lnga tsam byas shing*/ brtul zhugs kyi tshe chos dbyings ye shes lhag mar bzhag nas/ slob dpon gyi dbang gi tshe/ dkyil 'khor dang*/ lha dang*/ rdo rje dril bu sogs kyi de kho na nyid bshad nas/ thams cad ye shes su ro gcig par ngo sprad pa'i phyir dang*/

dbang gi rtogs pa brjod pa na/ lus rtsa dang*/ rtsa yi ge dang*/ khams bdud rtsi sogs gnas gyur pa nyid du ngo sprod pa'i phyir ro// sgrub byed gsum pas mi 'grub par bstan pa ni/ lung ma bstan lam du byed pa yod pas/ rnam smin gyi phung po lhar sgom mo// zhes gsung mod/ lam byed bshad pa'i don ni/ tha mal pa la lung ma bstan du 'char rgyu'i gnyid lta bu ste/ thabs la mkhas pas/ 'od gsal du bsgyur ba lta bu la 'chad mod/ de'i tshe lung ma bstan dang dge ba'i gzhi mthun khas blangs na/ sde snod chen po rnams kyi rnam gzhag dang 'gal bar 'gyur ro// de bas kyang cung zad rags pa/ nyon mongs pa byang chub kyi lam du byed pa zhig kyang bshad mod/ de'i tshe/ mi dge ba dang mthong lam lta bu'i gzhi mthun khas len pa ni ma yin gyi/ nyon mongs pa 'dod chags lta bu'i don dam pa'i ngo bo myong ba gsal rig gi cha de/ bdag byin gyis brlabs pa lta bu'i thabs mkhas kyis/ mthong ba'i lam du gnas gyur thub pa lta bu la bya ba yin gyi/ de'i tshe nyon mongs rang mtshan pa dang mthong lam gyi gzhi mthun gsang sngags pas khas len du ga la rung*/ sgrub byed bzhi pas kyang mi 'grub pa ni/ stag mor bsgoms pas gsal snang skyes pa ni/ sngags dang rdzas kyi nus pa las 'byung ba ste/ brdzus stag tu grags pa lta bu dang*/ keng rus ni/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi thob pas/ rgya mtsho'i mtha' klas pa nyid du khyab par spro nus pa dag bshad mod/ de dag ni 'jig rten tha mal pa'i dang*/ gnas skabs su lus gtsang 'dzin gyi gnyen por bshad pa tsam yod mod/ de 'dra kun ni/ yang dag pa ma yin pa'i don goms pas goms bya la gsal snang skye ba'i dpe yin gyi/ 'dir ni/ sangs rgyas nyid du grub par byed pa'i nyer len gyi rgyu dang*/ lhan cig skyes pa'i rkyen yin nges gcig ngos bzung nas/ de goms byed kyi yan lag dang ma bral bar goms pas/

mthar sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur nges pa'i shes byed kyi gtan tshigs yang dag gcig 'tshol dgos pa byung ba de'i tshe/ sangs rgyas pa'i lung ni/ phyi rol pa sogs kyi ngor sgrub byed du mi 'jug pas/ dngos po stobs zhugs kyi rigs pa nyid dgos shing*/ rigs pa de ni/ rnam 'grel mdzad pas bshad pa las lhag pa lta zhog mnyam pa tsam yang shing rta'i srol gzhan las ma byung ngo*// de yang gang zhe na/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab dang brtse ba snying rje chen po zung du 'brel ba de chos can/ goms byed kyi yan lag dang ma bral bar goms na/ goms bya'i don la gsal ba rab kyis mthar phyin pa 'byung du rung ste/ rten brtan byas zin/ 'bad rtsol bskyar ma la mi ltos/ goms pa rang gi ngang gis khyad par du 'gyur ba'i sems kyi yon tan yin pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa 'di/ chos kyi rjes rigs gter du gtan la phab pa yin no// de lta bu'i rigs pa de ni/ gzhi dus dang lam dus kyi rang bzhin rnam dag gi ye shes/ shes 'dod chos can du bzung nas/ bsgrubs na 'grub pa yin gyi/ rnam smin gyi phung po'am/ de ltar snang ba'i rnam rig gang chos can du bzung kyang*/ gtan tshigs gsum ga mi 'grub pas/ sgrub byed med do// re shig dang por/ rten brtan pa mi 'grub ste/ sngags lam gyi skye ba brgyud nas len pa ni/ skye ba bdun dang bcu drug lta bu la/ sangs rgya ba ni/ rnam smin gyi phung po snga ma 'dor zhing*/ phyi mas len pas/ brtan pa ma yin la/ lus dkyil brda 'phrod pa'i tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgya ba ni/ dus kyi 'khor lo dang*/ ma rgyud kyi gdams ngag pa dag gser 'gyur gyi rtsis/ lcags kyi khams zad par byas shing*/ gser du bsgyur ba ltar/ bdag byin gyis brlabs pa'i rim pas/ rnam smin phung po'i rang gi ngo bo zad par byed dgos pa nyid du bshad pas na/ mi brten par ma zad/ sangs rgyas kyi nyer len du yang ma bshad do// byas zin 'bad rtsol la mi ltos pa dang*/

ngang gis 'phel ba'i don yang*/ thabs gang dang gang gis/ chos nyid mngon sum du mthong ba dang*/ mthong nas 'bad rtsol la mi ltos par 'phel ba'i don yin la/ rnam smin gyi phung po lhar mthong ba ni/ ji ltar bzang yang bskyed rim las ma 'das la/ bskyed rim gyi lha'i sgrub gzhi yin ngo shes pa zhig las bsgrubs na/ chos nyid mngon sum du mthong srid kyang*/ sgrub gzhi ma yin pa las byung ba'i gsal snang ni/ de ma yin pa la der bzung ba'i phyir/ rtog med 'khrul shes las ma 'das so// mdor na bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ zag bcas kyi phung po'i gzhi mthun mi srid/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor dngos dang*/ rdul tshon dang ras bris sogs kyi gzhi mthun mi srid/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i mchod rdzas dngos dang*/ las nyon gyi bdag 'bras su gyur pa'i me tog sogs kyi gzhi mthun mi srid/ ma dag pa'i snod kyi 'jig rten dang*/ lha'i gzhal yas khang gi gzhi mthun mi srid do// zhes bya ba ni sgrub pa po chos kyi rjes 'brang dag gis/ 'chad tshe rnam par phye ba'i rnam gzhag shes par byas nas/ rnal 'byor du bya ba'i rim pa yin la/ ji skad bshad ma thag pa las log ste/ de dang de'i gzhi mthun pa nyid du zhen nas 'jug pa ni/ sgrub pa po dad pa'i rjes 'brang dag gis/ 'jug tshe gcig tu 'khrul pa'i rnam gzhag las gzhan ma shes pas/ yid la bya ba'i rim pa nyid du mdzad dgos pas na/ rnam pa kun tu dgag par bya ba ni ma yin no// dri ba 'di'i zhar byung gi skabs na/ lha yin yang kun rdzob bden pa srid ces dang*/ gzhi lam 'bras bu'i zung 'jug gi rnam gzhag re rang lugs su mdzad 'dug pa de la/ phyi rabs pa gzhan gyis btags pa'i chos skad 'dres pas/ 'di skad ces/ sangs rgyas kyi sas bsdus pa'i kun rdzob bden pa ni/ mdo sngags gnyis ka nas mi srid/ gzhan snang gi gzugs sku gnyis/ sems can gyis bsdus pa byams chos kyi lugs/

sangs rgyas dang sems can gnyis kas ma bsdus pa/ zla grags kyi lugs/ zung 'jug longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ don dam bden par 'jog pa/ sngags kyi lugs/ zung 'jug ces pa/ tha dad par gnyis su dbyer med pa'i chos skad/ zung 'brel zhes pa gnyis su dbyer yod pa'i brda skad yin pa de rnams bod phyi ma la mi snang ngo*// yang dri ba drug pa ni/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa la/ yid kyi sdom pa mi srid par bshad 'dug pa dang*/ mdo las/ dge bsnyen tsam gyis kyang mi dge bcu spong bar bshad 'dug pa/ mi 'gal lam gsungs pa ni/ spyir 'dul ba'i ming can la/ nyan thos kyi dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i dang*/ gsang sngags kyi dang gsum gsal bar bshad/ so so thar pa la'ang*/ nyan thos kyi dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i so so thar pa ni gsal bar bshad la/ gsang sngags la'ang don gyis grub/ sdom pa la'ang lus kyi dang*/ ngag gi dang*/ yid kyi dang gsum bshad/ 'dir nyan thos kyi 'dul ba dang*/ so thar ni bstan pa'i rtsa ba dang*/ theg pa thams cad la khyab byed thun mong ba yin/ byang sems kyi so thar ni/ theg pa gong ma gnyis la khyab byed du 'gro/ sngags kyi de dag ni thun mong ma yin pa'o// 'dir nyan thos kyi 'dul ba dang so thar gyi dbang du byas na/ 'di la yid kyi sdom pa mi 'chad/ so thar rigs brgyad po gang len kyang*/ yid kyi sdom pa ma blangs/ bslab bya brjod pa'i tshe yang*/ yid kyi nyes pa ma bshad/ dge slong gi sdom pa la ltos pa'i ltung ba 'chad pa'i tshe/ lus ngag gi rig byed gang du yang ma grub na/ yid kho na'i nyes pa la ni/ lci ba pham pa nas/ yang ba nyes bcas kyi bar gang du yang 'chad mi thub/ so thar sdom pa len dus kyi kun slong la/ 'khor ba spong sems dang*/ myang 'das la don gnyer dgos kyang*/ de sdom pa'i ngo bor mi 'chad/ yid kyi nyes pa'i mthar thug log par lta bas/ so thar gyi sdom pa rtsa ba nas gtong bar byed kyang*/

de dge slong gi sdom pa la ltos pa'i ltung ba sde lnga po gang du yang mi 'chad/ mdor na/ dge slong gi sdom pa la/ spong bdun 'khor bcas las gzhan mi 'chad pa dang*/ rigs brgyad ka la/ yid kyi sdom pa mi 'chad pa ni/ 'dul ba 'di'i lugs kyi mdo 'grel pa dang bcas pa'i dngos bstan rang yin pas/ yid gnyis 'tshal dgos pa med/ sdom gsum rab dbye 'chad dus kyi so thar sdom pa de yang*/ 'di kho na las gzhan du ma 'khrul cig de nas yang*/ dri ba bdun pa/ so thar sdom pa'i skabs su/ rig byed dang rig byed ma yin pa ci la zer zhes gsungs pa ni/ spyir rig byed ces pa lus ngag gi bya byed 'phral du mthong thos su gyur pa 'di las/ gzhan la ngos 'dzin rgyu med/ sdom pa len pa'i sbyor 'jug gi tshe/ rig byed mang po dgos kyang*/ sdom pa'i ngo bo rig byed du 'dod mkhan gyi theg pa che chung ba su yang med/ lus ngag gi sdom pa'i ngo bo/ rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs su 'dod pa/ bye brag tu smra ba kho na'i lugs yin/ de nas yang dri ba brgyad pa/ spyi bo sna tshogs rdo rje zhes pa'i don/ spyi bo'i dbang du byas pa'i chos nyid dam/ ye shes gang la 'chad kyang*/ skabs su ma bab pas/ nged mang po'i blor ma shong*/ ji ltar yin gsungs pa ni/ 'di la gnyis te/ dngos lan btab pa dang*/ sgrub byed bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ 'dir kyai rdo rje man ngag lugs kyi dbang du byas na/ spyi bo nas rkang brgyad kyi bar la kun rdzob kyi spyi bo sogs dang*/ don dam pa'i spyi bo sogs gnyis su 'byed dgos pa yin te/ 'jig rten gyi tha snyad byed pa'i tshe ni/ kun rdzob kyi spyi bo sogs gzhir 'jog la/ sgrub pa nyams len gyi tshe ni/ don dam pa'i spyi bo sogs dbang btsan pa yin te/ de dus kyi sna tshogs rdo rje nas/ ka ba brgyad kyi bar ni/ yul don dam pa'i bden pa dang*/ yul can ye shes kho na'i dbang du byas pa dang*/

mthar thug rigs 'dra'i rgyun ma chad pa sangs rgyas kyi sar 'gro dgos la/ kun rdzob kyi spyi bo sogs ni de dang der mi rung ba'i phyir/ nang gi lha grangs la yang de bzhin du sbyor dgos te/ lha'i ngo bo ni/ rang bzhin gsal stong dang*/ ngo bo zung 'jug du khas len dgos pa'i phyir dang*/ lus dkyil du dbang ma bskur bar ni/ nang gi bskyed rim sgom par mi rung la/ dbang de bskur ba'i tshe ni/ kun rdzob kyi gzugs kyi phung po mtha' dag mi dmigs par byas nas/ don dam pa'i gzugs phung gi ngo bo nyid du rtogs pa bskyed dgos pa'i phyir dang*/ kun rdzob pa'i gzugs phung ni/ rgyu ma rig pa las byung zhing*/ ngo bo ni gnas tshul la sgrib par byed pa zhig yin la/ don dam pa'i gzugs phung ni/ rgyu ye shes las byung zhing*/ ngo bo gnas tshul nyid yin pas/ de dang der sgom du rung zhing*/ sgom pa mthar phyin pa na/ sna tshogs rdo rje la sogs pa nyid du gsal bar snang du rung ba nyid yin no// de bas na rdo rje dril bu dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ slob dpon rnams la bden pa gnyis gnyis su phye nas/ dkyil 'khor la sogs pa'i de kho na nyid bshad pa bzhin dang*/ phyag dang mchod pa la yang*/ bden pa gnyis su phye nas/ nyams len gyi tshe don dam pa'i phyag mchod dbang btsan pa ni/ gsang sngags pa kun gyi lugs yin dgos pa las/ khyed rnam pa ltar na/ me tog phul zhes brjod pa'i tshe/ me tog gi dbang du byas pa'i gzung 'dzin gnyis med kyi ye shes la go ba blo yul du mi shong bar 'gyur ba de lta na ni/ bsang sbyang byin rlabs byas pa la 'bras bu ci 'byung*/ badz+ra puṣ+pe la sogs pa ci la zer bsam dgos pa yin no// ding sang*/ rang phyogs kyi gsang sngags pa dag ni/ zag bcas kyi phung po sbyang gzhi yin/ sbyang gzhi gang yin thams cad spang bya yin/ spang bya de thams cad lha dang gzhal yas khang yin/ zhes 'chad par snang ngo*// kho bo cag ni/

gsang sngags bla med ni theg pa kun gyi rtse mo yin la/ der slebs nas phyi rol gyi don khas mi len/ der snang ba'i rnam rig la/ rnam shes dang ye shes kyi cha gnyis su phye nas/ dang po ni/ 'khrul snang dang las snang las ma 'das pas spang bya kho na nyid kyi phyir/ swa bhā was dmigs med du gtong gi lha dang gzhal yas khang du mi bskyed do// gnyis pa sgrub byed bshad pa ni/ bka' 'khor lo bar pa'i nang nas/ shes bya'i rnam pa re re la kun btags gzhan dbang yongs grub gsum gsum du phye/ de'i dgongs pa 'grel pa na byams pas/ de ma rdzogs dang rab rdzogs dang*// zhes gsum po gnyis su bsdus nas/ snga ma gnyis yon tan gyi rten du ma rdzogs pas/ kun rdzob kyi bden pa dang*/ yongs grub gcig pu yon tan gyi rten du rdzogs pas/ don dam bden par gsungs/ bka' 'khor lo gsum pa byams chos su bcas pa'i dgongs 'grel/ dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa na/ rnam par rtog pas brtags pa'i don// kun tu brtags pa'i ngo bo nyid// rnam par rtog pa gzhan gyi dbang*// de yi chos nyid yongs su grub// ces snga ma gnyis/ kun tu rtog pa dang rnam shes kyi dbang du byas pas na kun rdzob dang yongs grub kho na don dam pa'i bden par gsungs/ de'i phyir gzugs sgra la sogs pa re re'i steng du/ mtshan nyid gsum gsum dang*/ bde ba gnyis gnyis su phye nas/ phar phyin theg par bsod nams tshogs gsog gi tshe/ kun rdzob bden pa'i snang cha mi 'gog pas thad sor 'jog rdo rje theg pa rang lugs kyi bsod nams tshogs gsog gi tshe/ kun rdzob dmigs med du byas nas/ ye shes kho na'i rnam rol gyis/ tshogs gnyis po gtso cher mnyam par bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor gyis rdzogs par byed pas na/ tshogs gnyis ka don dam bden pa dbang btsan/ de'i phyir sngags lugs su tshogs gsog pa la grangs med gsum gyi yun mi 'gor/ bla med pa/

tshogs dang po rdzogs byed kyi gtso bo bskyed rim yin/ de goms pa'i thog mar/ stong pa nyid la mnyam par 'jog cing*/ de las ma bzhengs pa'i ngang nyid nas/ rim pa dang po sgom par byed/ phar phyin pas ni/ ji skad du/ bsod nams 'dod pas stong pa nyid// kun tshe'ang brjod par mi bya ste// zhes 'phags pa lhas dang*/ zla bas/ dge mi dge med blo can thar 'gyur te/ las 'bras rnams la sems pa'ang dgag pa mdzad/ ces/ theg pa gnyis kyi bsod nams tshogs gsog la/ bden pa gnyis po gang dang gang dbang btsan/ zhes bsam par byas nas/ don dam pa'i bden par gyur pa'i spyi bo dang rkang mthil sogs la/ som nyid mdzad mi 'tshal lo// rang lugs pa phyi ma dag na re/ shes bya'i rnam pa re re la/ gsum gsum du 'byed pa ni rna bas ma tshor/ spyir shes bya la kun btags sogs gsum du 'byed pa ni/ sems tsam pa'i lugs so// zhes zer/ 'o na/ rje btsun grags pas/ gur rgyan du/ kun btags la gzhan dbang gis rgyas 'debs/ gzhan dbang la yongs grub kyis rgyas 'debs zhes gsungs la/ rgyas 'debs ni nyams len gyi thabs kyi gtso bo yin/ de sems tsam lugs su byed dam/ 'o na ci zhe na/ kun rdzob kyi chos gang yang rnam shes la snang tsam las ma gtogs/ gzhan yod pa ma yin par thag gcod pa ni/ kun btags la gzhan dbang gi rgyas 'debs yin/ kun rdzob par snang ba'i rnam shes de yang*/ 'khrul par thag bcad nas/ ye shes 'ba' zhig lhag par 'jog pa ni/ gzhan dbang la yongs grub kyi rgyas 'debs yin/ ye shes de yang*/ rnam shes yul dang bcas pas dben zhing*/ ye shes nyid bskyed rdzogs kyi rnam rol sna tshogs su 'char zhes thag gcod pa ni zung 'jug gi don no// zhes bya ba ni grub pa'o// dri ba dgu pa ni/ dbang po rtul 'bring gis/ swa bhā wa zhes sogs nas/ so sor ngo sprod dgos pa med do zhes pa'i bar gyi don ci yin gsung ba ni/

phal cher gong du bshad zin pa dag tu 'dus sam snyam du bsams nas/ zur pa ma bris so// dri ba bcu pa ni/ gser gyi thur mar/ sbyang gzhi brgya yi dbye bas dam pa rigs brgya sogs// ji ltar 'byed pa'i tshul ni zhes pas nas// gong ma'i dgongs pa skong rnams ran par smros// zhes pa'i bar/ 'gag 'dril ba zhig gnang bar zhu/ zhes gsungs pa la/ rang re 'di pas/ sbyang gzhi dri ma dang bcas pa'i sems kyi chos dbyings dang*/ sbyang bya dri ma gnyis dang*/ sbyong byed lam rim pa gnyis su kha tshon bcad pa la/ sa skya pa gong ma'i dgongs pa 'chad zer ba dag na re/ sbyang gzhi chos dbyings la 'chad pa/ gang nas kyang ma bshad/ sbyang gzhi dang sbyang bya'i dbye ba gong mas mi bzhed/ sbyang gzhi gang yin thams cad spang bya yin// zhes 'chad pa dang*/ yang kha cig sbyang gzhi/ sbyong byed sbyang bya gsum ka rnal 'byor pa rang gi lus gcig pu/ thabs kyis zin ma zin gyi bye brag las/ so sor phye ba tsam yin zhes 'chad pa dag yod par grags so// de la bzhad gad du bya ba'i phyir/ rgyu rgyud sbyang gzhir bzhag pa ma bltas zhing*// zhes sogs/ tshigs bcad gcig pu de smras par snang ngo*// 'di'i don la gsum ste/ mthar thug dang gnas skabs kyi sbyang gzhi ngos bzung ba/ sbyang gzhi dang sbyang bya so sor dbye dgos pa'i shes byed dgod/ lus so sor brtags pa'i 'gog pa sbyong byed lam du 'gro tshul bshad pa/ de la rtsod pa spang ba'o// dang po la/ mthar thug gi sbyang gzhi ni/ dri ma dang bcas pa'i chos dbyings ye shes dang*/ khams bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po dang*/ rang bzhin du gnas pa'i rigs zhes bya ba'i ming can rnams te/ dper na/ rnyog pa dang bcas pa'i chu dang*/ g.ya' dang bcas pa'i gser dang*/ sprin dang bcas pa'i nam mkha' bzhin no// rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi man ngag las/ mthar thug gi sbyang gzhi ni/ kun gzhi rgyu rgyud la 'chad pa yin la/

de dang snga ma gsum po don gcig ming gi rnam grangs yin mod/ lam 'bras pa phyi ma dag ni/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes la 'chad par snang ngo*// sbyang bya mthar thug ni/ sgrib pa gnyis kyi sa bon dang bag chags te/ de sbyong nus pa'i shes byed ni/ sbyang gzhi dang 'bral rung yin pa'i phyir/ dper na/ rnyog pa dang*/ g.ya' dang*/ sprin bzhin no/ sbyang gzhi de dag ni spang bya ma yin te/ thabs kyis rgyu rgyud spangs na/ 'bras rgyud mi 'grub pa'i phyir ro// sbyong byed kyi gnyen po mthar thug ni/ lam rim gnyis po/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sar slebs pa de'o// gnas skabs kyi sbyang gzhi rags pa ni/ sgrub pa po la yod pa'i zag bcas kyi phung khams skye mched rnams te/ de'i mtshan gzhi ni/ bdag dang phung sogs su snang ba'i rnam rig tsam las gzhan yod pa ma yin te/ theg pa 'dir zhugs nas/ sems las gzhan pa'i chos dang gang zag khas mi len pa'i phyir/ sbyang bya ni de lta bu'i rnam rig de la ldog pa'i sgo nas/ nang blta ye shes kyi cha dang*/ phyi blta rnam shes kyi cha gnyis su phye nas/ phyi ma de yin la/ 'di ni yang dag pa ma yin pa'i kun tu rtog pa dang khyab mnyam la/ nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa dbang dang mngon gyur du ldan pa rnams so// sbyong byed gnyen po ni/ nang blta ye shes kyi cha las bsgrubs pa'i lam rim pa gnyis su yod la/ 'di dang po/ rtog pa'i ngo bor skyes srid kyang*/ sngags kyi tshogs lam du bzhag nus shing*/ de yang*/ bskyed rim ni gtso bor nyon sgrib sbyong byed dang*/ rdzogs rim ni gtso bor bde chen gyi sgrib pa'i ming can shes bya'i sgrib pa dag gi gnyen po'o// gnyis pa ni/ sbyang gzhi dang sbyang bya so sor 'byed dgos pa'i shes byed ni/ sbyang gzhi dang sbyang bya don gcig pa ma yin te/ mthar thug gi sbyang gzhi ni chos dbyings yin pas/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes dang spang bya'i gzhi mthun/

bstan pa 'di la mi srid do// sbyang bya'i dri ma gang yin sbyang gzhir 'jog pa yang ma shes pa yin te/ dri ma ni rnam pa kun tu spang bya kho na yin pas/ gnas su 'jog pa'i go skabs med la/ sbyang gzhi ni gnas kyi don yin zhing*/ de la brten nas gnas gyur gyi rnam gzhag 'jog pa'i phyir/ gzhan dag gis ni/ sbyang gzhi sbyong ba dang spang bya spong ba'i khyad par ma phyed do// khyad par de nyid ci zhe na/ sbyang gzhi rang gi ngo bo ni/ sems can nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bar rgyun mi chad par 'gro la/ spang bya ni/ rang rang gi gnyen po bar chad med lam nam skyes pa de'i tshe rtsa ba nas 'don pa'o// sbyang gzhi dang sbyang bya khyad med du 'chad pa de dag rang rang gi ngag 'don na/ rnam par shes pa'i phung po gnas gyur nyon mongs zhe sdang dag /ces sogs lnga tshan gcig goms pas 'don par byed pa ma yin nam/ de'i phyir yang*/ gnas gyur pa dang spang bya spangs pa'i khyad par shes sla ba yin no// mdor na/ gnas gyur 'chad pa'i dus kyi/ gnas kyi ngos 'dzin de yin na/ don dam pa'i bden pa nyid du gnas dgos pa de'i phyir/ bod phyi ma gang dag sbyang gzhi la kun rdzob bden pas khyab par 'dod pa'ang nyams so// gal te/ gong ma dag gis gzhi mi spong ba'i 'thad pa gsungs pa des/ sbyang gzhi spang bya ma yin pa la ji ltar phan zhe na/ zag pa dang bcas pa'i phung khams skye mched ji snyed pa ni/ rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi sbyang gzhir mi 'dod pa su yang mi snang la/ de'i tshe/ theg pa mchog gi nyams len byed pos/ bskyed rim gyi tshe yang*/ de dag spong bar byed pa mi 'thad cing*/ rdzogs rim gyi tshe yang*/ de dag spang byar byas na shin tu 'gal ba yin no// de yang gang gi phyir na/ bskyed rim gyi zab shos ni/ nang bskyed pa'i rim pa zhes bya ba de yin la/ zag bcas kyi phung khams skye mched ji snyed pa/ gnas dang brten dang sbyang gzhir ma bzhag na/

de la brten pa'i zag med kyi lus dkyil/ gang du gnas pa dang*/ ji ltar sgom pa dang*/ des dri ma gang sbyong ba'i tshul rnams mi shes pa'i phyir dang*/ khyed rang dag kyang*/ bsgom bya lus dkyil zag bcas kyi lus su khas len pas kyang gnod pa'i phyir/ rdzogs rim gyi tshe/ zag bcas kyi phung khams skye mched spangs na/ zag pa med pa'i bde chen gyi ye shes 'dren par mi nus pa'i phyir te/ de dag de'i med na mi 'byung ba'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir ro// dper na ji skad du/ 'dod pa'i yon tan thams cad la// ci 'dod par ni brten bzhin du// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ zag bcas kyi 'dod yon lnga/ ma spangs par brten pas/ zag med kyi yon tan lnga skye bar 'chad dgos pa bzhin no// 'o na khyed kun rdzob kyi bden pa mtha' dag rang stong du 'chad pa ma yin nam/ lam gyi gnas skabs su ji ltar mi spong zhe na/ chos can kun rdzob pa rnams/ ye shes kyi yul du yod pa ma yin pas/ lam du mi 'gyur yang*/ ye shes skye ba'i sna 'dren du/ rnam shes lhan skyes kyi yul du gyur pa rnams kyang bsten dgos pa ni/ rdo rje theg pa pa rnams kyi thabs mkhas kyi khyad par yin te/ ji skad du/ shin tu bde ba dam pa'i thabs// 'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la// ci 'dod par ni brten bzhin du// zhes gsungs so// de bas na mnyam gzhag tu mi dmigs pa dang*/ rjes thob tu bsten dgos pa'i shan phyed pa gal che'o// 'o na/ mnyam gzhag gi tshe yang*/ kun rdzob kyi spyi bo dang rkang mthil sogs su/ sna tshogs rdo rje sogs bkod nas sgom pa ma yin nam zhe na/ de tshe ni/ lhag pa'i lha nyid kyi spyi bo sogs de dang der sgom pa yin zhes bshad zin la/ de ltar goms pas/ rnal 'byor pa rang gi rnam shes kyi yul du gyur pa'i spyi bo sogs/ gnas gyur pa nyid du byed do// zhes 'chad pa ni/ skabs kyi don no// gsum pa ni/

gal te zag bcas kyi phung khams skye mched rnams/ lam rim pa gnyis kyi ngo bor mi rung na/ rdo rje'i tshig rkang du/ lus thabs rgyud ces dang*/ lus la brten nas bde chen gyi sgrib pa 'gag ces dang*/ lus so sor brtags pa'i 'gog pa zhes bshad pa rnams dang 'gal lo snyam na/ lan la gnyis te/ spyir bshad pa dang*/ dngos lan btab pa'o// dang po la/ spyir sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa la gnyis te/ so so skye bo dang 'phags pa'o// phyi ma la yang gnyis te/ slob pa dang mi slob pa'o// rnal 'byor pa dang pos/ lam rim pa gnyis la slob pa'i tshe/ mnyam gzhag dngos gzhi'i dus su ni/ rlom tshod la don dam pa'i bden pa 'ba' zhig yul du byed pa yin te/ de'i tshe/ ye shes kyi tshogs gsog sngon du btang ba las ma bzhengs pa de'i ngang nyid nas/ lam goms par byed pa'i phyir/ song tshod la ni/ kun rdzob yul du byas par song ste/ rten 'di la rnal 'byor mngon sum ma skyes pas/ don dam yul du byed mkhan gyi blo de yang rtog pa las ma 'das pa'i phyir/ de lta na yang*/ 'jug yul don dam pa la 'brel bas na mi bslu ba nyid do// 'phags pa slob pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ mnyam gzhag dngos gzhi'i dus su/ lam rim pa gnyis kyi dngos por gyur pa'i don dam yul du byed pa yin te/ 'dis chos nyid mngon sum du mthong nas/ ji srid bya ba ma rdzogs kyi bar du/ don de nyid la mnyam par 'jog pa'i nus pa thob pas so// rten 'dis/ rdzogs rim la 'jug pa'i sbyor ba'i dus su ni/ kun rdzob kyi bden pa yul du byed de/ rdzogs rim gyi ye shes dngos su 'dren pa'i thabs/ rang lus zag bcas kyi rtsa rlung thig le rnams yul du byed dgos pa'i phyir dang*/ bde chen gyi ye shes thog mar skye ba la ni/ de 'dra de dag med na mi 'byung ba'i rgyu nyid kyi phyir ro// rjes thob kyi tshe yang de dang 'dra ste/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo sogs/

mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor du bshad pa rnams nyams su len pa'i phyir dang*/ ji srid gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gi bag chags ma spangs pa de srid du/ rnal 'byor pa rang snang gi yul can rnam shes la/ yul kun rdzob pa'i snang ba 'char bas so// rnal 'byor pa mi slob pa la ni/ 'bras dus kyi rim pa gnyis dag pa rab 'byams 'ba' zhig tu 'char te/ gnyis snang gi bag chags ma lus par spangs pas/ rnam par shes pa'i chos nyid las 'das pa'i phyir dang*/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes lhun gyis grub pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa dngos lan btab pa ni/ lus la brten nas bde chen gyi sgrib pa 'gag pa dang*/ lus so sor brtags pa'i 'gog pa ni/ lus kyi thabs las byung ba'i bde chen nyid las gzhan du mi 'chad de/ ji skad du/ lus la ye shes chen po gnas// zhes dang*/ lus gnas lus la ma skyes pa// zhes gsungs so// ma skyes pa ni/ lus la skyes na lus tshor bde ba nyid thal bas so// 'dod nus pa ma yin te/ rtog pa thams cad yang dag spangs// zhes gsungs pas so// lus thabs rgyud kyi bshad pa ni/ lus kyi sgra 'jug pa na kun rdzob dang don dam pa gnyis las/ phyi ma ni thabs rgyud du ha cang thal ba med de/ lus kyi dbang du byas pa'i gnyis med kyi ye shes la 'dod pas so// de lta na yang*/ lus thabs rgyud ces pa'i rtsa tshig gi skabs 'dir/ zag bcas kyi lus la thabs rgyud du ming gis btags pa yin te/ 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ de la gnad du bsnun pas bde chen gyi ye shes 'dren pa'o// dgos pa ni/ ye shes de 'dren pa zag bcas kyi lus la rag las par shes pa'i don du'o// dngos la gnod byed ni/ las dang nyon mongs pa kho na'i rnam smin dang rgyu mthun nyid kyi phyir ro// gal te/ rnal 'byor pas/ de las de 'dren pa'i tshul ji lta bu zhe na/ rang lus zag bcas kyi dkyil 'khor rnam pa bzhi dang por dbang gis smin pa dang*/

bar du lam gyis grol ba dang*/ tha mar 'bras bu la mtshams sbyor ba'o// dang po ni/ rang lus rtsa'i dbyibs can la bum pa dang*/ rtsa yi ge la gsang ba dang*/ khams bdud rtsi la gsum pa dang*/ snying po ye shes la bzhi pa'i dbang bskur bas/ dkyil 'khor bzhi po so so'i dri ma 'khrud cing*/ sbyangs pas gnas gyur gyi nus pa mthu can du byed pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ lus rtsa sogs bzhi po la/ so sor gnad du bsnan pas/ thog mar lta ba bzhi dang*/ de nas grub mtha' bzhi rtogs par 'gyur ba yin te/ nang bskyed pa'i rim pa dang bdag byin gyis brlabs pa'i rim pa gsum po goms pas/ lta grub bzhi 'khor 'das dbyer med nas/ bde stong rgya che ba'i bar rim gyis 'dren pas so// rdzogs rim dngos ni/ grub mtha' gtso che ba yin te/ spang bya'i sa bon drung 'byin pa ni/ sa thob pa la rag las pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ rnal 'byor pa ji srid slob pa'i sa la gnas pa de srid du/ res 'ga' ni/ rang lus kyi dkyil 'khor bzhi po/ gzung 'dzin gyi lam du zhugs nas/ rang lus bem po'i khams nyid du skyed par byed cing*/ rnam smin gyi srog 'dzin par byed/ res 'ga' ni/ bzhi po dbu ma'i lam du 'bad rtsol gyis bcug nas/ zag med don dam pa'i lus su dang*/ 'ja' tshon lta bu'i sku grub par byed do// de yang*/ dang po ni/ sbyor 'jug gi dus dang*/ phyi ma ni dngos gzhi'i dus so// gsum pa ni/ de ltar dkyil 'khor bzhi po/ gzung 'dzin 'khor ba'i lam dang*/ dbu ma mya ngan las 'das pa'i lam du 'jug ldog byed pa de la ni/ 'gros zhes bya la/ bzhi po dbu ma'i lam du song nas/ slar mi ldog par byas pa de la ni/ 'gros bzhi thim pa zhes dang*/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa grub pa zhes bya'o// de'i phyir rnam smin gyi lus 'di sangs rgyas kyi sar 'gro dgos pa ma yin zhing*/ 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku de la rten dang brten pa mtha' dag gsal ba nyid du mthar phyin pa de la/

sku dbyibs sprul sku rang bzhin lhun grub dang*/ de dus kyi bde stong zung 'jug de la/ gsung longs sku dang*/ thugs chos sku/ rang bzhin lhun grub gnas gyur mthar phyin pa zhes bya ba de yin no// bzhi pa ni/ gal te 'o na/ bskyed rim dngos gzhi'i dus su kun rdzob kyi snang ba 'gog la/ rdzogs rim dngos gzhi'i dus su kun rdzob kyi snang ba yul du byed pa ci zhe na/ de ni bskyed rim gyi thog mar ye shes kyi tshogs gsog la rtsal du 'don pa dang*/ rdzogs rim gyi dus su de ltar byed pa ma yin pa'i khyad par las so// 'o na/ rdzogs rim dngos gzhi'i dus su/ mtshan 'dzin gyi rtog pa 'gog dgos pa ma yin nam zhe na/ dus der/ rlung sems dbu mar tshud pa tsam gyis/ rtog pa rang shugs kyis khegs pa na/ rnam shes kyi ming can rtog med rnams kyang nye bar zhi ba nyid do// yang gal te/ sbyang bya'i dri ma spong la/ sbyang gzhi mi spong ba'i khyad par de ltar na/ lam du chags sogs ched du gnyer nas spong mi spong gi khyad par las/ rdo rje'i theg pa 'dir chags lam dang grol lam zhes gnyis su 'byed pa ma yin nam/ de ltar 'chad pa de'i ngos 'dzin ni/ bdag po'i rkyen rang byin gyis brlabs pa'i rim pa la/ dbang thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ lhan cig byed pa'i dmigs rkyen/ tha mal gyi chags pa'i yul mngon du byas pa na/ skad cig dang por lus tshor bde ba skyes pa de'i ngo bo/ rig cing gsal tsam gyis/ de ma thag pa'i rkyen byas nas/ skad cig phyi mar bde ba chen po nyid mngon du gyur pa de la ni/ chags pa chen po zhes bya la// de nyid lam du byed pa ste// ji skad du/ mchod pa chen po chags pa che// chags pa thams cad sel bar byed// ces gsungs so// de bzhin du gti mug dang zhe sdang la yang sbyar te gsungs so// gal te/ sbyang gzhi rnams rang stong du thag gcod na/ mi spong bar 'gal ba ma yin nam zhe na/

gnas skabs la ltos te/ de skad zer na ni/ dbu ma pa kun gyi tha snyad dang mi mthun la/ mthar thug la ltos nas ni/ bden pa gnyis kyi dbye bas so sor 'byed do// zhes bya ba 'di grub pa'o// de ltar na/ bstan bcos su bgyi ba/ 'di pa dag gis nye bar sbyar ba'i yig sna bzhi tshan gcig gzigs pa la brten nas/ bshes gnyen dam pa mang pos dogs pa'i gnas bkod pa'i dri ba bcu phrag gcig mdzad nas springs 'dug pa/ lo shas bar skabs su bgyang mchis na'ang*/ lag tu son ma thag do gal chen pos lan 'debs kyi yi ge pho nya ba'i phyag tu gsal bar springs pa 'di ni/ phag mo hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes bcu la grub pa'o// //swasti/ de nas yang*/ rang stobs kyis/ dri ba rnam grangs bzhi mdzad byung ba las/ dang po ni/ byams chos sde lnga'i skabs su/ gzung 'dzin gnyis med kyi ye shes 'dus byas su bzhed na/ de'i rgyu dang rkyen gang lags/ zhes gsungs pa de'i lan mdor bsdus pa ni/ gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ming can la gnyis te/ rang bzhin rnam dag gi dang*/ glo bur rnam dag gi ye shes so// gnyis po yang*/ 'bras dus su ni ldog pa kho nas 'byed la/ lam dus su dag pa phyogs re ba tsam dang*/ gzhi dus su rang bzhin rnam dag kho nar gnas pa las/ 'di dag la/ 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas kyi mtshan nyid ji ltar tshang tshul 'chad pa la gnyis te/ byams chos pa'i srol 'dzin spyi pa'i lugs dang*/ rnam 'grel mdzad pa'i lugs bye brag tu bshad pa'o// dang po la/ rang bzhin rnam dag gi cha ni/ gnas skabs gsum char du yang*/ 'dus ma byas pa kho na yin te/ ji skad du/ thog ma dbus mtha' med pa yi// rang bzhin yin phyir 'dus ma byas// zhes pas/ sgrub byed dang 'dus byas la gnod byed kyang*/ de ltar na/ mi rtag par thal ba las/ 'dod mi nus pa ni/ rgyud blar/ 'dus ma byas pa'i dbyings la ni// rtag pa la sogs don zhes bya// zhes rtag brtan zhi ba g.yung drung nyid du tshig gis zin pa dang*/

khyab pa tshad mas grub pa'i tshul yang*/ mdo sde rgyan du/ 'dus byas thams cad skad cig mar sgrub pa'i tshul rgyas par gsungs so// dbyings de'i mtshan gzhi ni/ gzhi dus su khams bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po dang*/ rang bzhin du gnas pa'i rigs dang*/ don dam pa'i sems can zhes dang*/ lam dus su don dam pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ 'bras dus su/ gtsang bde rtag bdag gi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ste/ ngo bo nyid kyi sku'o// 'di yang*/ thog mar/ sngar med gsar skye dang*/ mthar rigs 'dra rgyun bcad kyi 'jig pa mi srid pas na/ thog mtha' med pa dang*/ skye 'jig med pa zhes bya la/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis sus kyang ngos 'dzin par mi nus mod/ gnas pa khas mi len pa ni ma yin te/ rtag gnas dang zhes 'chad pa'i phyir/ de lta na yang*/ dngos por ni khas len dgos te/ chos dbyings su 'jog pa'i sgrub byed ni/ ji skad du/ 'phags pa'i chos kyi rgyu yi phyir// zhes gsungs pa la/ rgyu'i don ni 'bras bu skyed byed dang*/ de la ni don byed nus pa zhes 'chad pa'i phyir/ dngos po la mi rtag pas khyab pa ni/ srol 'di'i spyi lugs la med do// gnyis pa glo bur rnam dag gi ye shes ni/ gnas tshul gyi sku lhag ma gsum dang*/ lam dus su yang rnam par grol ba'i lam dag la ngos 'dzin dgos la/ de'i nye bar len pa'i rgyu ni/ thog med nas rgyun ma chad pa'i rig pa snga ma dang*/ rkyen bar chad med lam gyi stobs las so// rang bzhin rnam dag gi cha la'ang rig pa snga ma nyid rgyur yod pa ma yin nam zhe na/ de ma thag pa'i rkyen yod kyang*/ dmigs bdag sogs rkyen gzhan la ltos pa med pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ 'dus ma byas pa'o// 'o na/ seng ge bzang pos/ bcos ma ma yin pa'i don gyis zhes bshad pa ma yin nam zhe na/ de ni/ dag pa gnyis po ldog pas so sor phye nas/ rkyen la ltos ma ltos gnyis ka 'grel pa der gsal lo// de'i phyir glo bur rnam dag gi 'gog pa dang ye shes kyi tshogs don la bshad pas na/

gnas skabs 'dus byas su 'chad dgos pa'i phyir/ mi rtag par grub la der grub pa na/ yod pa ma yin pa nyid du grub ste/ ji skad du/ mi rtag don ni med don dang*// zhes pa/ chos 'di'i srol yin pas so// de'i phyir lugs 'dir/ chos kyi dbyings las ma gtogs pa'i chos gzhan med la/ dbyings de yod pa nyid kyi phyir/ rtag sogs bzhi dang don dam pa'i bden pa dang*/ bden par grub pa nyid do// 'o na/ 'gog pa'i bden pa 'dus byas su khas blangs pa ma yin nam zhe na/ bden par 'jog pa ni ye shes kyi cha nas yin la/ bral cha ni/ rkyen la ltos kyang gzhan sel nyid kyi phyir/ dngos por yod do// 'o na/ chos kyi dbyings su 'gal lo zhe na/ zhib mor 'gal mod/ rags pa'i tshe/ so sor brtags 'gog dang bden pa so sor mi 'byed pa'i skabs shin tu mang bas/ 'chad 'jug gi skabs nas shes dgos so// gnyis pa rnam 'grel mdzad pa'i lugs ji ltar yin pa la gnyis te/ gnas skabs 'gal ba can dang*/ mthar thug dgongs pa gcig pa'i tshul lo// dang po ni/ byams chos spyi las de ltar bshad kyang*/ rnam 'grel nges las/ yod pa nyid la mi rtag pas khyab pa dang*/ mi rtag pa'i don skad cig ma gcig tu yang mi gnas pa la bshad pas na/ dgongs pa dpyis phyin pa shes par dka'o// rigs gter las/ med pa rtag nyid gang las yin// zhes pa'i lung drangs nas/ rtag pa nyid la dngos pos khyab pa dang*/ de ltar 'dod pa yang rtag smra ba'i lugs yin pa dang*/ chos kyi grags pa ni/ 'jig pa bkag tsam la/ rtag pa'i tha snyad 'dogs kyi/ rtag pa mtshan nyid pa mi bzhed pa dang*/ nam mkha' dang*/ so sor brtag 'gog dang*/ brtags min gyi 'gog pa dang*/ don spyi dang*/ med pa gsal ba rnams tshad mas mi grub pa nyid dang*/ rnam 'grel mdzad pa'i dgongs par bshad do// de ltar bshad pa'i tshe/ dngos med dang rtag pa lta ci smos/ dngos po'i chos kyang yod par khas len rgyu zhig ma byung bas/

byams pa'i chos kyi bshad srol du/ rtag pa'i dngos po zhig nges don mthar thug tu bshad pa las brgal bar nus zhe na/ rnam 'grel du dngos po dang dngos med rnams rtag pa nyid du mi srid par bshad kyang*/ chos dbyings rtag brtan sogs ma yin par ma bshad byams chos rtsa bar chos dbyings rtag brtan sogs su bshad kyang*/ gzhan dbang gi dngos po zhig de dang der bshad pa med/ mdor na/ sde bdun du bshad pa'i dngos po dang dngos med gang rung yin na/ kun btags dang gzhan dbang gi dngos po gang rung yin dgos/ byams chos rtsa bar bshad pa'i rtag dngos de yin na/ ji skad du/ srid gsum skye 'jig med pa'i dngos// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ skye 'jig med pa'i dngos po zhig yin dgos pa'o// 'o na/ skye 'jig yod med kyi dngos po'i khyad par gang gis 'byed ce na/ kun btags dang yongs grub kyi dang*/ kun rdzob dang don dam gyi dang*/ chos can dang chos nyid kyi dngos po'i khyad par gang yin pa dag go /'dir smras pa/ chos 'khor gsum pa'i chos kyi skad// mthong ba lta ci thos pa yang*// bslabs pa lta ci slob 'dod kyang*// nyin skar lta ci nam mkha' yi// pad+ma ji bzhin pa dus 'dir// nyid dang nyid cag dang 'dra ba// gzhan yang da dung gzhan dag tu// sems pas ngal bar mi 'gyur ram// kho bo kho nas chos 'di la// ngal bas de ring ngal bso thob// dri ba gnyis pa ni/ khro phu lots+tsha ba'i bsngo ba rin chen phreng ba na/ yod pa'i dge ba zhes bshad pa de/ ci la zer gsungs pa/ bka' phyag pa'i bsngo ba rnying pa thams cad kyi nang na/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis/ dus gsum du bsags yod pa'i dge ba rnams/ phyogs gcig tu bsdoms pa'i mthu la brten nas zhes sogs 'byung la/ de yang phal po cher/ 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// zhes sogs kyi dgongs par 'chad cing*/ yod pa de'i ngos 'dzin/ gshegs pa'i snying po la 'chad pa sogs/

dgag bzhag rgyas par sdom gsum gyi bstan bcos su mdzad zin pas/ 'dir mi spro la/ rang gis rnam par brtags pa ni/ spyir dge ba la/ ma byas pa dang byas pa gnyis// dang po ni/ rang bzhin du gnas pa'i rigs so// 'di'i ming gi rnam grangs la ni/ don dam pa'i bdag ces bya zhing*/ sems can kun la kun rdzob pa'i dang*/ don dam pa'i bdag gnyis gnyis gsal bar phye nas/ gang gis bsngo bar byed pa po dang*/ gang du bsngo bar bya ba'i yul dang*/ gang bsngo bar bya ba'i dngos po rnams so sor ngos bzung nas/ smon lam la yang de bzhin du sbyar nas/ bsngo ba'i tshe/ gang gis bsngo bar byed pa po ni/ kun rdzob pa'i gang zag dang*/ byed pa po las sog pa ste/ ji srid lhag med kyi myang 'das dang*/ sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ma rig pas kun tu sgro btags pa'i nga'o snyam pa'i 'dzin stangs kyi gzung bya de nyid do// gang du bsngo bar bya ba'i yul ni/ blo'i bye brag gis mngon par mtho ba dang*/ nges par legs pa gnyis so// phyi ma la yang*/ dman pa'i lhag bcas dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi gzugs kyi sku gnyis so// so so skye bos ni lhag med du bsngo bar mi bya ste/ bdag chad kyis dogs pa'i phyir ro// don dam gyi bsngo ba'i tshe/ bsngo ba po don dam pa'i bdag dang*/ bsngo yul sangs rgyas kyi chos sku dang*/ bsngo bya ye shes kyi tshogs rang gis bsags pa dang*/ gzhan la rjes su yi rang ba sogs so// de bzhin du smon lam la yang*/ bsngo ba ji lta ba bzhin du/ kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i dbye ba smon lam la yang sbyar nas/ thun mong du shes par bya zhing*/ thun mong ma yin pa ni/ bsngo bya dang smon bya'i rdzas kyi khyad par las te/ kun rdzob kyi nga sogs skyes bu bcu gnyis po nyid/ mngon par mtho ba dang*/ lhag bcas dang*/ gzugs kyi sku gnyis su gyur cig pa'i smon lam so sor 'debs pa yin la/

don dam pa'i smon lam gyi tshe ni/ smon par bya ba'i dngos po/ don dam pa'i bdag gam/ gzhi dus kyi chos dbyings ye shes sam/ khams bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po nyid/ blo'i bye brag gis lhag med kyi myang 'das sam/ sangs rgyas kyi chos sku nyid du gyur cig pa'i smon lam 'debs par byed do// dam pa'i bdag 'di la dgongs nas/ ji skad du/ nga de'i tshe de'i dus na zhes sogs dang*/ nga lung bstan par gyur ces/ rgyal ba de skad gsung*/ zhes bshad do// de'i tshe/ nga dang bdag sogs sangs rgya bar gyur cig ces pa ni/ smon lam du mi rung na ni/ smon lam rgyun chad par 'gyur la/ bsngo bya'i rdzas su ni mi rung ste/ bsags pa'i dge ba ma yin pa'i phyir dang*/ ma bsngos kyang log lta sogs kyis gzhom mi nus pa'i phyir dang*/ ma bsngos kyang sangs rgya rung nyid du/ ngo bo nyid kyis gnas pa'i phyir dang*/ dge rtsa chad pa'i gang zag kun la'ang yod pa'i phyir dang*/ smon lam la ni/ gnas dang gnas ma yin pa gnyis su gsungs mod/ bsngo ba ni/ gnas kyi bsngo ba kho na nyid du mdo las gsungs pa'i phyir ro// 'on kyang bde gshegs snying po'i ngos 'dzin stong nyid med dgag gi cha la 'chad pa ltar na/ dge bar yang mi rung la/ 'khor lo gsum pa'i dgongs pas/ ma yin dgag gi cha nas ngos 'dzin pa ltar na/ dge bar bshad pa'i rnam grangs mang yang*/ gang zhig bsngo bar bya ba'i dngos po nyid du mi 'chad pa ni/ rje btsun sa skya pa dag gi bzhed pa'o// smras pa/ rang dang gzhan gyi phyogs dag la// chags dang sdang bas ma yin par// lung dang rigs pas sbyang 'di la// khyed dang 'dra ba gzhan dag kyang*// dga' dang gus pa mang bar mdzod// dri ba gsum pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa bcu gnyis sogs/ 'jig rten mthun 'jug la dgongs na/ dga' ldan gnas nas 'pho ba'i tshe/ glang po che'i gzugs su byon pa ji ltar yin gsung ba 'di la ni/

mdzod kyi 'grel par/ dris lan gyi sgo nas lan btab zin par 'dug la/ de yang*/ ji skad du/ de ni 'phen pa gcig pa'i phyir// sngon dus srid 'byung sha tshugs can// zhes pa la/ rgol ba ni/ de ltar na/ skye ba gcig gis thogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa'/ 'dzam gling du 'pho ba'i bar srid glang po che'i rnam pas byon pa la/ ci zhes pa/ bar srid dngos ni/ mi'i byang chub sems dpa' gzhon nu mtshan dpes spras pa gcig las 'os med kyang*/ yum lha mo sgyu 'phrul gyi rmi lam du de ltar bstan pa ni/ don dang dgos pa 'ga' zhig mtshon pa'i phyir yin te/ dper na/ rgyal po kri kri'i rmi lam lung bstan pa'i mdo las 'byung ba bzhin no// zhes pa nyid lan no// dri ba bzhi pa ni/ sher phyir gyi mdo las gzugs stong pa'o// zhes dang*/ bstan bcos las/ gzugs ni stong nyid mi rigs te// zhes sogs 'gal ba lta bur snang ba/ ci gsung ba 'di la/ gnyis te/ dngos lan btab pa dang*/ shes byed bkod pa'o// dang po ni/ mdo'i dngos bstan la bshad tshul gnyis yod kyang*/ khyad gzhi nyid du gzung byar gyur pa'i gzugs sogs ji snyed pa/ gdod ma nas yod ma myong ba ni/ stong pa'i don no// brgyad stong don bsdur/ de skad bshad pa'i dgongs pa ni/ thogs med zhabs kyis phye ba'i shing rta'i srol las byung ba ste/ gzugs ni zhes pa/ mtshon pa tsam ste/ kun btags su gyur pa'i gzugs nas rnam mkhyen bar gyi thams cad do// stong nyid ces pa la/ gzung 'dzin kun btags khegs pa'i med dgag nam mkha' lta bu dang*/ gnyis stong des khyad par du byas pa'i ye shes dag la ngos bzung nas/ khyad gzhi gzugs sogs de dang de thams cad chos can du gzung nas/ stong nyid ces pa khyod kyi ngos 'dzin de dang de ma yin pa'i shes byed du/ stong nyid ces bya gzugs dang bral// gzugs ni rnam pa dang 'brel yin// zhes bkod pa'o// mdor na/

kun btags dang yongs grub phan tshun 'gal ba'i shes byed do// 'gal zhes pa yang*/ rtog ge pa ltar/ gnyis ka yod mnyam du khas len pa ni ma yin te/ phyogs kyi glang po'i srol 'di la/ kun btags ji snyed pa rang stong du bshad pa'i phyir/ 'o na/ rnam pa dang 'brel ba ci zhe na/ rnam shes la de ltar snang ba'o// 'o na/ kun btags su gyur pa'i stong nyid dang rnam mkhyen sogs ji lta bu zhe na/ de 'dzin rtogs pas de dang der bzung ba la/ de dang de nyid du sgro btags pa'o// gnyis pa shes byed bkod pa ni/ stong nyid bzhi sbyor gyi 'grel tshul la/ shing rta'i srol snga phyi gnyis las/ dang po/ byams chos kyi lugs ltar na/ kun btags dang gzhan dbang gi chos thams cad ni stong pa'o// de yang dang po/ rang stong nam mkha'i me tog lta bu dang*/ gnyis pa/ gzhan stong sgyu ma lta bu ste/ de dag ni/ yod pa sgro 'dogs kyi mtha' sel byed do// med par skur 'debs kyi mtha' sel byed ni/ stong pa nyid gzugs so zhes pa/ stong nyid kyi ngos 'dzin/ gzung 'dzin gnyis su med pa'i ye shes de nyid/ gzugs so zhes pa/ gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar thams cad kyi/ dbang du byas pa'i chos nyid gzugs la sogs pa yin la/ de ni rtag pa dang bden pa'o// de ltar sgro skur gyi mtha' gnyis bsal ba'i don bsdu ba ni/ gzugs las kyang zhes dang*/ stong pa nyid las kyang zhes pa'o// lugs 'di la chos kyi dbyings dang stong pa nyid las ma gtogs pa'i chos gzhan med la/ dbyings de dag ni/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i ye shes kho na'i spyod yul dang*/ bden pa'i dngos por gyur pa'o// srol 'byed gnyis pa ni/ dbu ma ngo bo nyid med pa dag gi srol te/ gzugs stong pa'o zhes pa/ blo'i yul du byar rung ba thams cad gdod ma nas yod ma myong ba'o// stong pa nyid gzugs so zhes pa/ gang la stong pa nyid rung ba// de la thams cad rung ba yin// zhes bshad pa ltar/

gnas tshul stong pa nyid du mi rung na/ snang tshul rten 'brel sna tshogs 'char ba yang mi rung zhes pa'o// gzugs las kyang zhes pa'i mdo gnyis ni/ gzugs sogs kun rdzob pa dang*/ de'i chos nyid stong pa nyid du tha snyad byas pa rnams de nyid dang gzhan du brjod du med pa'o// 'dir ni sgro skur la sogs pa'i spros pa thams cad/ stong pa nyid dam rten 'brel kho nas sel nus pa yin te/ spyir btang du/ yin min dang yod med la sogs gang du khas blangs kyang*/ stong nyid dang rten 'brel du 'chad mi nus pa'i phyir/ deng sang pa dag na re/ chos gang yang yod pa ma yin na/ las 'bras sogs la skur pa btab zer mod/ kho bo cag ni/ de dag med par yang khas mi len pa'i phyir dang*/ ltos grub tu khas len pa'i phyir dang*/ kun rdzob tu yod par khas len pa'i phyir/ spros pa'i mthar lhung ba med do// lugs 'di la yang chos kyi dbyings las ma gtogs pa'i chos gzhan mi srid la/ dbyings de ni/ yod pa lta zhog med pa sogs gang yang rung ba gcig tu/ gnas pa med cing*/ khas len du yang rung ba ma yin pa la dgongs nas/ tshig gsal du/ 'phags pa rnams kyi don dam ni// cang mi gsung ba yin no zhes dang*/ zhi ba lhas/ don dam blo yi spyod yul min// zhes gsungs so// de lta na yang*/ shes par bya ba ni yin te/ 'jig rten pa'i thos bsam sgom pa las byung ba'i shes rab kyis shes dgos pa'i phyir dang*/ yab sras mjal ba'i mdor/ shes par bya ba yang gnyis po 'di tsam kho na yin te/ kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i bden pa'o gsungs pa yin no// //swasti/ 'di na bden dang bden pa min pa'i gtam gang gsal bar smra nus gang yin bcom ldan thub pa de ni ring du gshegs// de gsung bdud rtsi mang por gyur pa'i bka' dang bstan bcos ding sang 'di na dpang por bzhugs snyam byed pa yin mod kyang*// glegs thag 'khril shing mang pos dam par 'khyud pa'i glegs bam dpag bsam dbang po mun pa'i khri la bzhugs par gyur min nam// de don 'byed pa'i nyin byed bgrang yas spro byed mkhan ni deng 'dir shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo// 'dri bar 'dod na shes la 'dri// go bar 'dod na gzigs pas go

/mkhas la bslabs na kun la mkhas// 'chad po mang yang chos mi 'chad// 'chad mkhas gcig pus 'di na 'chad// rtsod par dgongs nas mkhas la rtsod// rtsom pa po ni gzhung bzhin rtsom// da lan 'di tsam springs so da// bzhed pa yod na 'dir yang bzhed// spro bar nus so rang sems spro// dge ba'i bshes kyis mdzad 'di dge /la la mkhas mkhas 'dod 'dod nas// mang mang thos thos byed byed po// skabs don skabs las ma nyams sam// 'ga' 'ga' btsun btsun bzang bzang po// cang mi smra 'ga' cang yod dam// mkhas par mkhyen nas 'dir dris sam// som nyi bsal phyir dris kyang rung*// rang gzhan gzhung lugs rgya mtsho yi// pha rol phyin nas 'di springs so// de yi dge ba rnam dkar po// mtshan mar 'dzin kun las grol ba// mtha' yas gdul bya'i tshogs rnams dang*// thams cad mkhyen mtshor ro gcig shog /ces/ gzi bsam grub chos sde nas/ mang du gsan zhing sgrub pa la gzhol ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa dge 'dun dpal gyis dul zhing dge bar dris pa'i lan/ ya mtshan bcu bdun pa zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dpal shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blos/ chu mo phag gi lo khrums kyi nya ba'i yar tshes bco lnga la/ gtsang gser mdog can gyi chos grwa nyid du/ lhag pa'i bsam pas sbyar te springs pa'i yi ge pa ni bsod nams ye shes lhun grub bo// //shu bhaṃ// // ༄༅// swasti/ dris lan 'di mdang sang dar nas ya mtshan bcu bdun po gang yin gsung byung ba/ sngon byon bod yul gyi theg chen pa rnams bden pa gnyis kyi 'jog tshul mthun pas rang rang gi chos brgyud 'dzin nus pa'i yon tan phyis byon kun rdzob tshad grub kyi gzhung btsugs pa'i rjes su phal che ba dag 'brangs pas rang rang gi lugs 'khrugs pa'i skyon can/ rnal 'byor spyod pa'i dbu ma dang*/ thal rang gi dbu ma dang*/ sngags kyi dbu ma gsum grub mtha' bzhi rtse mor gzhung tshugs shing*/

nang tshan gyi dbye ba so sor 'byed pa'i tshul gsum dang*/ nyan rang gi lta ba yang dbu mar tshud pas mthar ma lhung ba'i yon tan dang bzhi tshan gcig snga ma gnyis dang drug go /dpal ldan chos skyong sngags kyi dbu mar zhugs pa'i yon tan gyis/ thal rang ba'i dbu mar ma zhugs pa'i tshul dang*/ rnal 'byor spyod pa'i dbu ma nas sngags kyi dbu mar 'jug pa bde zhing*/ dngos gzhi'i nyams len mthun pa'i tshul/ thal rang gi dbu ma nas/ sngags kyi dbu mar 'jug pa mi bde zhing*/ dngos gzhi'i nyams len mi mthun pa'i tshul/ de'i shes byed/ sngags kyi gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi ngo bo don dam dang ye shes su mtshungs shing*/ thal rang gi gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi gtso bo phal cher med dgag tu mtshungs pa'i tshul/ de lta na yang phar phyin theg pa rkyang pas/ sangs rgya ba la de tsam gyis chog cing*/ sngags su mtha' gnyis po la tshul de dang mtshungs pa yod kyang de las lhag pa gzhan med par bstan/ de ltar 'chad pa rje btsun sa skya pa'i dgongs par grub pa ste/ drug tshan gcig kun gzhi rgyu rgyud kyi ngos 'dzin kun gzhi ye shes sam zag pa med pa'i sems rgyud la bshad nas/ sbyang gzhi'i mthar thug sgrib bcas sems kyi chos dbyings la 'chad dgos pa dang*/ sbyong byed rim pa gnyis po/ rloms tshod la/ don dam pa'i bden pa kho nar nges kyang*/ las dang po pas thog mar rnam shes kyis zhugs shing*/ sa thob nas ye shes kho na'i rnam rol gyis 'jug par bstan pa dang*/ shes bya'i rnam pa re re la yul bden pa gnyis gnyis su phye zhing*/ yul can rnam shes dang ye shes gnyis gnyis su 'byed pa/ theg pa chen po'i nyams len mtha' dag la dgos par bstan pa dang*/ de yang rjes thob dang rjes 'jug gi tshe yul can rnam shes dang yul kun rdzob dbang btsan zhing*/ mnyam gzhag dang nyams len dngos gzhi'i tshe yul can ye shes dang*/ yul don dam dbang btsan pa bstan/

gzhi lam du don dam pa'i sems can gyis/ ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pas/ 'bras dus su chos skur sangs rgya ba dang*/ gzhi lam du kun rdzob pa'i sems can gyis/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pas 'bras dus su gzugs skur sangs rgya ba rnams so// de ltar ya mtshan bcu bdun po// lus rnam gzhag yin de las kyang*// gyes pa'i ya mtshan bcu bdun po// yan lag rgyas bshad de las kyang*// nying lag ya mtshan bcu bdun po// yod do shes rab can gyis sbyor// de ltar ya mtshan bcu bdun phrag /gsum gyis bskor ba'i skyed tshal nas// dgos 'dod dpag bsam 'dod 'jo ni// shes rab spyan yangs stong 'dzin pa'i// brgya byin nye dbang dang bcas kyi// 'chi med bdud rtsi'i 'bab stegs mchog /thog mar 'di bzung de nas ni// bod chen sngon ma'i gsung rab gzigs// de nas theg pa chen po yi// bka' dang bstan bcos mtha' dag gi /nges pa'i don la gdeng thob nas// phyis byon gtam gyi rol mo mkhan// kun gyi de nyid mthong bar gyur// //maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
